description: Source code implementing socket utility functions for QUIC protocol on Linux, including message header management, control message handling, socket options, and packet transmission.

classes.name: QuicMsgHdr
classes.description: Represents a message header for sending/receiving UDP packets with ancillary data.

classes.name: QuicMMsgHdr
classes.description: Manages multiple message headers for batch UDP transmission.

methods.name: SetIpInNextCmsg
methods.description: Sets IP address info in the next control message.

methods.name: GetNextCmsgDataInternal
methods.description: Retrieves and prepares the next control message data buffer.

methods.name: InitOneHeader
methods.description: Initializes a message header with buffer and peer address.

methods.name: SetIpInNextCmsg
methods.description: Sets IP address info in the control message for a specific index.

methods.name: GetNextCmsgDataInternal
methods.description: Retrieves and prepares control message data for a specific index.

methods.name: num_bytes_sent
methods.description: Calculates total bytes sent based on the number of packets.

methods.name: GetUDPSegmentSize
methods.description: Retrieves the UDP segment size socket option.

methods.name: EnableReleaseTime
methods.description: Enables release time socket option for timestamping.

methods.name: GetTtlFromMsghdr
methods.description: Extracts TTL value from message header control messages.

methods.name: SetIpInfoInCmsgData
methods.description: Populates control message data with IP address info.

methods.name: SetIpInfoInCmsg
methods.description: Prepares a control message with IP address info.

methods.name: WritePacket
methods.description: Sends a single packet using sendmsg.
